name: Mineral & Walnut
basis: Original Option 1 before the playbook crossover; retain subsequent functional requests, never Option 2 furniture assumptions.
palette: Warm ivory and soft mushroom mineral walls
rules: New furnishings are budgeted without credits for furniture already owned.
Do not import the Cocoa & Chrome material board, owned furniture photographs, polished-stainless casegoods, smoky brown-oak storage or blue/yellow accent program.
Furniture silhouettes may vary, including legs, floating construction and plinth bases where suitable. Option 2’s universal no-legs rule does not apply.
Roman Clay is selective on dry focal walls; washable matte paint elsewhere and appropriate waterproof assemblies at wet areas.
Bedrooms retain individual identities within the original palette.
Bedroom 5 is a new room to construct, not an existing finished room. Its render is proposed.

audit.note: Original 45 views reviewed for style continuity. Restoration retains the documented limitations of plan-led rooms and alternate cameras; it does not certify dimensions.
